name: oxide-lofi-color
description: Lo-fi / driven tape color via the UADx Oxide Tape Recorder. Repro, 7.5 IPS (the 'more colored, greater frequency shift' speed -> leaner lows, more upper color), NAB, NR off (let the modeled hiss/hum add vibe), input_level +14 for heavy odd-3rd saturation (~7-10% THD) + tape compression (crest 14.6 -> ~12). The grit/character setting, not the polite glue.
intended_for: a drum bus, loop, beat, or stem you want to make sound 'recorded to cheap tape' — color over cleanliness.
plugin_build: uaudio_oxide_tape.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; the 'UAD Oxide Tape.component' twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it).

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on watercolors_drums_104bpm_8bar_a (peak-normed). dry centroid 3007, crest 14.63. drive +12 on the SAME chain measured cen 3145 / crest 12.45 / THD 7.7% odd.

notes: input_level is the drive AND the saturation: +12 = ~7.7% THD, +18 = ~24%, +24 = ~38% (odd ladder 3rd -> 5th). The harmonics are ODD (3rd-dominant) like real tape; brightness RISES as you drive (centroid 2990 -> 3800 over +0 -> +24).

7.5 IPS is the 'colored/frequency-shift' setting here (leaner 20-200, more 4-16k) -- the textbook 'slow = bigger bass bump' is INVERTED on this model; switch to 15 IPS if you want the warm low-end instead.
NR off keeps the modeled tape hiss/hum for vibe; flip on if it distracts (tonally transparent either way).
For brighter lo-fi swap emphasis_eq -> CCIR. To tame the grit, drop input_level. Place before any bus comp.
Verify: measure-distortion (THD), measure-loudness (crest), measure-spectrum (centroid up = the drive). Pairs with [[vst-saturate]] / [[vibe-analog-machines]].
